name: Serin
summary: Serin is defined by a white marble top that brings a crisp, luminous elegance to the design. The body and short legs are wrapped in dark grey matte elm veneer, giving the piece a rich, textured sophistication. Inside, melamine panels keep the interior clean and refined. A tall leg finished in brass metallic paint adds a warm, sculptural accent, lifting the whole composition into a modern, high end statement. Top with White Marble, the body and two short legs cover with elm veneer in dark grey matt. the inner panels with melamine, The high leg paint in brass metallic. 55×41.5×50
